newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: WINTERTHUR SEES FASTER '97 EARNINGS GROWTH.
newsitem.headline: WINTERTHUR SEES FASTER '97 EARNINGS GROWTH.

text.p: Winterthur Group said it expects its group net profit to grow faster in 1997 than the year before, when it rose 21 percent.
Winterthur chairman Peter Spaelti also said the group expected to report "a very good interim result on September 30."
"The sustained and marked increase in profits since 1992 will be continued in 1997," Spaelti said in a copy of speech released before a joint news conference with Credit Suisse.

"Subject to extraordinary events in the remaining months of the current business year, we expect growth in profits which will be above the previous year's (plus 21 percent) as well as a considerable incresae in shareholders' equity," Spaelti said.
In 1996 Winterthur's group net profit rose 20.9 percent to 506.7 million Swiss francs.
